description: Suggest fields for one collection from a sample of its items' meta.custom values (published data, else drafts) — writes nothing. Returns { sampled, suggestions: [{ field: { key, type, options? }, count, samples, defined }], skipped }. Review, then add the ones you want via put_collection_schema.

collection.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections returned it, e.g. "blog/" or "posts".

name: infer_collection_schema
